عجوا (form I)
# عَجُّوا (ʕajjū) /ʕad͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عُجُّوا (ʕujjū) /ʕud͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
# عِجُّوا (ʕijjū) /ʕid͡ʒ.d͡ʒuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of عَجَّ (ʕajja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
